library(tidyverse)

# View(hotel_booking)
#filtering data

hotel_booking_city <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "City Hotel")

hotel_booking_resort <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel")

hotel_booking_2 <- select(hotel_booking, 1:7, 15:29)
#peak seasons

hotel_city_adr <- hotel_booking_city %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%                                                                
   summarise(avr_adr_city = mean(adr))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.

## ℹ Output is grouped by arrival_date_month.

hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%

## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.

# Identifying sectors for non-refundable deposits 
# Sorting Resort Hotel bookings 

resort_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

resort_risk_table <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by risk_group and lead_time_groups.
## ℹ Output is grouped by risk_group.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(risk_group, lead_time_groups))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
resort_risk_table_sorted <- resort_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))
# Sorting city hotel bookings 

city_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

city_risk_table <- city_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by risk_group and lead_time_groups.
## ℹ Output is grouped by risk_group.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(risk_group, lead_time_groups))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
city_risk_table_sorted <- city_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))
# Visualizing for resort hotel 


library(ggplot2)
ggplot(resort_risk_table, aes( x = lead_time_groups, y = risk_group, fill = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Risk Analysis for Resort Hotel",
    y = "Distribution Channels",
    x = "Booking Time"
  ) +
  theme_gray() 

# Visualizing for city hotel 

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(city_risk_table, aes( x = lead_time_groups, y = risk_group, fill = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Risk Analysis for Resort Hotel",
    y = "Distribution Channels",
    x = "Booking Time"
  ) +
  theme_gray() 

#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for city hotel 

cancellations_by_channel_city <- hotel_booking_city %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_city = n(),
    total_cancelled_city = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_city = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_city)

##   distribution_channel total_number_bookings_city total_cancelled_city
##   <chr>                                     <int>                <int>
## 1 Corporate                                  3408                  786
## 2 Direct                                     6780                 1232
## 3 GDS                                         193                   37
## 4 TA/TO                                     68945                31043
## 5 Undefined                                     4                    4
## # ℹ 1 more variable: percentage_cancelled_city <dbl>
#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for resort hotel

cancellations_by_channel_resort <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_resort = n(),
    total_cancelled_resort = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_resort = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_resort)

#Graph for cancelled bookings for each distribution channel for city hotel

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(cancellations_by_channel_city,
       aes(x = reorder(distribution_channel, -percentage_cancelled_city),
           y = percentage_cancelled_city,
       fill = distribution_channel)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage_cancelled_city, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Distribution Channel",
    y = "percentage cancelled (%)",
    title = "Percentage of bookings cancelled across each distribution channel for City Hotel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
